snippet.title: DDoD – Official Playtest №1 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the quarantine zone...

We invite players to try out DDoD during October 3–5
Join the closed Playtest #1, explore early mission, and help shape the future of the game.

👇Wishlist now on Steam and request playtest access to secure your spot now!👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468200/?utm_source=trailer&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=playtest_oct2025
